Motion Makers Women's Mountain Bike Ride

Asheville, NC · Bent Creek · Mountain bike

Motion Makers Women's Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Asheville, NC. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Ledford Branch Trailhead, Bent Creek.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Motion Makers Women's Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A no-drop women's mountain bike ride on the Bent Creek trails. Six to eight miles of forest singletrack. The shop also runs a no-drop Saturday morning ride from the same trailhead. Confirm with the shop before driving out.
